2607.05968.title: InfluMatch: Frontier-Quality KOL Search at 4B-Model Cost
2607.05968.paper_summary: Matching influencers (KOLs) to free-form, multi-part Thai marketing criteria is today served either by keyword search over structured profiles, which misses semantic fit, or by prompting frontier LLMs over every candidate, which is accurate but slow and expensive. We present InfluMatch, a low-cost three-stage cascade -- retrieval $\rightarrow$ rerank $\rightarrow$ reason -- built entirely from small open-weight models: dense retrieval returns 50 candidates, a 4B pointwise reranker scores each by the log-probability of a single Yes token and keeps 10, and a 4B reasoner grades the shortlist per criterion on a rubric with a Thai rationale. The cascade is designed for cost: reasoning over a filtered top-10 halves token spend versus reasoning over all 50 while scoring 14 points higher. End-to-end against human relevance labels on an 11-query set with all 50 candidates labeled, the full cascade reaches 94.1% P@5, versus a retrieval-only baseline near random; it matches the frontier model Kimi-K2.6 (91.8%) while emitting ${\sim}35\times$ fewer output tokens and serving a 50-KOL query in ${\sim}20$ s on one A100. Notably, the only fine-tuning that pays off is pairwise: a SimPO-tuned reranker matches the frontier baseline's best-pick accuracy (78.0 EM), whereas fine-tuning the reasoner on pointwise per-criterion labels improves offline scores yet degrades end-to-end ranking -- an inversion we trace to the design of the absolute labeling task -- leaving the untuned base model as the strongest deployed reasoner. The result is a deployable, explainable KOL search system at a small fraction of frontier serving cost.
2607.05968.paper_summary_zh: 將影響者（KOLs）與自由形式的多部分泰國市場行銷標準匹配，今天的做法要麼是通過結構化檔案的關鍵字搜索，這樣會錯過語義上的適配，要麼是對每個候選者進行前沿LLM的提示，這雖然準確但速度慢且成本高。我們提出了InfluMatch，一個低成本的三階段級聯 -- 檢索 $\rightarrow$ 重新排序 $\rightarrow$ 理由 -- 完全由小型開放權重模型構建：密集檢索返回50個候選者，一個4B點對點重新排序器根據單個“是”標記的對數概率為每個候選者打分並保留10個，還有一個4B推理器根據泰國的標準對短名單進行評分。該級聯的設計考慮了成本：對過濾後的前10名進行推理的令牌消耗是對所有50名進行推理的一半，同時得分高出14點。在針對人類相關性標籤的11個查詢集上，對所有50個候選者進行標記，完整的級聯達到94.1%的P@5，而僅檢索的基準接近隨機；它與前沿模型Kimi-K2.6（91.8%）相匹配，同時輸出令牌數量約為${\sim}35\times$更少，並在一個A100上以${\sim}20$秒的速度處理50-KOL查詢。值得注意的是，唯一有效的微調是成對的：一個SimPO調整的重新排序器達到了前沿基準的最佳選擇準確率（78.0 EM），而對推理器進行點對點的標準標籤微調雖然提高了離線得分，但卻降低了端到端的排名 -- 我們將這種反轉歸因於絕對標籤任務的設計 -- 使未調整的基礎模型成為最強的部署推理器。最終結果是一個可部署、可解釋的KOL搜索系統，其成本僅為前沿服務成本的一小部分。
